items.title: Two dualizing complexes differ by tensoring with an invertible object
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that any two dualizing complexes on a Noetherian ring differ by the derived tensor product with an invertible object (author lemma at source lines 2918-2925, label lemma-dualizing-unique). The proof (source lines 2927-2947) applies the earlier description of equivalences to obtain an invertible object isomorphic to the internal hom from one dualizing complex into the other, uses the finite tor dimension of that object to invoke the hom-evaluation isomorphism on bounded coherent complexes, and evaluates at the first dualizing complex to read off the asserted quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 2928-2946). The construction of the invertible object and the evaluation step are the substance. H3.
